derived_context.scope: Approximate annual campus context only; precision is not warranted and no load profile follows from this

unresolved_inputs.needed_for: Sector limits; no real P44/depot transformer rating is asserted
Power flow and transformer apparent-power loading
Calibration; annual energy cannot replace a time series
Weather/seasonal dispatch rather than nameplate power
Storage is mentioned publicly but actual size/control are unknown
Availability, charging deadlines and operational coupling
No CHP phase-out claim without heat/cooling replacement model
Verify additional TestingLab value instead of duplicating existing planning

guardrails: No operational model parameters are auto-created from this dossier.
Public asset counts do not establish electrical capacity, utilization or availability.
Targets and announced projects must not appear as current installed assets.
No airport partnership, endorsement, privileged data access or empirical validation is claimed.
A planning stress scenario is not evidence that Munich Airport currently has an overload or outage.
